Acceptance criteria:
- AC1: No orphans. Balanced wrapping on headings and "pretty" wrapping on body text, toasts and cards, so no single word hangs on its own line. [JK typography] QW (source: DESIGN_TOUCHES touch 18)
- AC2: Real keycaps. Shortcuts shown as small keycap shapes, and they switch between Cmd and Ctrl by platform. [Raycast, Superhuman] QW (source: DESIGN_TOUCHES touch 19)
- AC3: Live relative times. "4 min ago" updates on its own without shifting the layout, and the exact Lagos time shows on hover. [Vercel, GitHub] QW (source: DESIGN_TOUCHES touch 21)
- AC4: Three-layer hairline shadow instead of flat 1 px borders on light surfaces: crisp edge, soft contact, faint lift. [JK ui] QW (source: DESIGN_TOUCHES touch 23)
- AC5: Machined top edge. Floating panels (menus, command bar, term card) get a 1 px inner highlight on the top edge, like a milled aluminium edge. [Apple, Raycast, Playbook 4] QW (source: DESIGN_TOUCHES touch 24)
- AC6: Focus dims the world. When a sheet or a serious confirmation opens, the rest of the app fades and loses some colour rather than going black. [HIG dimming, Arc] QW (source: DESIGN_TOUCHES touch 27)
- AC7: Test vs Live you can feel. Test copies get a faint diagonal hazard band along the top edge and tinted chrome; Live databases get clean chrome. Nobody publishes to the wrong place by mistake. [Vercel preview deployments, Heroku] QW (source: DESIGN_TOUCHES touch 28)
- AC8: A colour for each database. Each connected database picks a colour from a curated set, used on its switcher chip, tabs and favicon dot, so you always know where you are. [Arc Spaces, Slack workspaces] QW (source: DESIGN_TOUCHES touch 29)
- AC9: Images that sit on anything. Every logo and image gets a 1 px outline at 10 percent, so white logos on white cards still have an edge. [JK ui] QW (source: DESIGN_TOUCHES touch 31)
- AC10: Hold to confirm. Risky actions (remove demo data, roll back a release) use a hold button that fills over about 1.2 seconds; letting go cancels. Calmer than "type DELETE". [Emil hold-to-delete] QW (source: DESIGN_TOUCHES touch 34)
- AC11: Flick to dismiss. Sheets and panels can be flung away on touch and trackpad, with soft resistance at the edges. [Emil gestures, Vaul] QW (source: DESIGN_TOUCHES touch 39)
- AC12: Blur bridge for data swaps. Charts and big numbers crossfade through a 2 px blur when the data set changes, app-wide (the proof PDF swap already uses this). Refines SPEC 7. [Emil] QW (source: DESIGN_TOUCHES touch 40)
- AC13: Sonner-quality toasts. Toasts stack with depth, fan out on hover, swipe away, and pause their timer on hover or when the tab is hidden. Refines the planned undo toast. [Sonner] QW (source: DESIGN_TOUCHES touch 41)
- AC14: Snap feedback. When dragging on the canvas, snapping gives a tiny 1 px nudge and a brief guide-line flash. [Figma smart guides] QW (source: DESIGN_TOUCHES touch 42)
- AC15: Drag with weight. A dragged item lifts with a growing shadow, tilts slightly with speed (3 degrees at most) and settles flat on drop. [Things, Emil springs] QW (source: DESIGN_TOUCHES touch 43)
- AC16: all 162 design touches implemented in full; built ones re-checked inside their area rebuild (source: ledger UIX-TOUCHES, Tope 21 Oct; DESIGN_TOUCHES)
